name: Studio demo catalogue
note: Forty invented short-video records written for this demonstration. They are not KuaiRec items and not real videos. Each has a title, a description, one existing category, existing tags and a fixed base score that stands in for the recommender's relevance.

items.title: Ten-minute garlic noodles
items.description: A home cook fries garlic in butter, tosses in noodles and finishes with parmesan and chilli flakes. Steam rises off the plate in the final shot.

items.title: Night market dumplings in Taipei
items.description: Close-ups of pork dumplings pleated by hand, dropped into a steamer and served with black vinegar at a busy night market stall.

items.title: Chocolate lava cake, step by step
items.description: Step by step: melt chocolate, whisk eggs and sugar, fold, bake for nine minutes, then cut the cake so the molten centre pours out.

items.title: Sunday meal prep for the week
items.description: Five lunch boxes of rice, roasted vegetables and chicken are portioned and labelled for the working week.

items.title: Full-body workout, no equipment
items.description: A trainer leads a twenty-minute session of squats, lunges, push-ups and burpees. Expect to sweat by the third round.

items.title: Morning yoga for stiff backs
items.description: A slow, quiet yoga flow with deep breathing, gentle twists and a long rest at the end. Suitable for beginners.

items.title: First 5K race vlog
items.description: A runner films the last kilometre of her first five-kilometre race, gasping for air as she sprints to the finish line.

items.title: How to deadlift safely
items.description: A coach explains grip, hip hinge and bar path, then demonstrates three common mistakes and how to correct each one.

items.title: Sunrise over the Dolomites
items.description: A hiker reaches a ridge before dawn; the camera holds on the mountains as the light turns from blue to gold. No talking, only wind.

items.title: Lisbon in 60 seconds
items.description: Fast cuts of yellow trams, tiled facades, custard tarts at a bakery and the view from a hilltop lookout.

items.title: Overnight train across Norway
items.description: Snow-covered valleys pass the window of a sleeper cabin; the traveller shows the bunk, the dining car and the frozen lakes at dawn.

items.title: Budget backpacking packing list
items.description: Everything for two weeks fits in a 30-litre bag; the creator lists each item and its price.

items.title: Fingerstyle guitar lesson: part 1
items.description: A teacher breaks a simple fingerpicking pattern into four slow steps and plays each one twice so viewers can follow along.

items.title: Rainy-night lo-fi piano
items.description: Soft piano chords over the sound of rain on a window; a looping animation of a sleeping cat on a desk.

items.title: Festival drum solo goes wild
items.description: A drummer plays a three-minute solo at an outdoor festival while the crowd screams and jumps.

items.title: Choir sings in a cathedral
items.description: Twenty singers perform a slow hymn; the echo of the stone hall carries every note.

items.title: Speedrun world record attempt
items.description: A player races through a retro platformer in under twelve minutes, reacting loudly to every near miss.

items.title: Horror game jump scares compilation
items.description: Streamers scream at the scariest moments of a survival horror game set in an abandoned hospital.

items.title: Cozy farming game: building a greenhouse
items.description: A relaxed playthrough of a farming game: planting tomatoes, decorating a greenhouse and feeding the chickens.

items.title: Esports final: last-second comeback
items.description: Commentators shout as a team wins the championship final in the last five seconds of overtime.

items.title: Golden retriever meets the ocean
items.description: A puppy runs into the waves on a sandy beach for the first time, then shakes water all over its owner.

items.title: Cat ignores a tiny cardboard castle
items.description: An owner builds an elaborate cardboard castle; the cat sleeps in the empty shipping box instead.

items.title: Teaching a parrot to wave
items.description: A trainer uses seeds as rewards and shows, step by step, how the parrot learns to lift one foot on cue.

items.title: Goats on a mountain farm
items.description: A herd of goats climbs rocks in an alpine pasture while a farmer calls them home for the evening.

items.title: Fix a leaking tap in five minutes
items.description: A plumber shuts off the water, replaces the cartridge and shows how to test for drips, one step at a time.

items.title: Building a bookshelf from pallets
items.description: Sanding, cutting and screwing recycled pallet wood into a three-shelf bookcase, with a circular saw and a power drill.

items.title: Small balcony garden makeover
items.description: Herbs in hanging pots, a folding chair and fairy lights turn a bare balcony into a quiet evening spot.

items.title: Patching a hole in drywall
items.description: Cut a square, fit a backing board, apply joint compound in thin coats, sand and paint. Each stage is timed.

items.title: Why the sky is blue, explained
items.description: A physics teacher shines white light through a tank of cloudy water to show how scattering separates colours.

items.title: Elephant toothpaste experiment
items.description: A chemist mixes hydrogen peroxide, yeast and soap; a column of foam erupts out of the flask in seconds.

items.title: Night sky time-lapse of the Milky Way
items.description: Four hours of stars wheel over a desert campsite; a narrator names the brightest planets in a calm voice.

items.title: How vaccines train the immune system
items.description: An animated explainer follows a white blood cell as it learns to recognise a virus.

items.title: Budgeting with the 50/30/20 rule
items.description: A planner splits a monthly salary into needs, wants and savings, and shows the spreadsheet she uses.

items.title: I tried living on $10 a day
items.description: A creator records every purchase for a week, cooks rice and beans, and counts the money left each night.

items.title: Index funds in 90 seconds
items.description: A presenter explains what an index fund holds and why fees matter, using coins on a table as props.

items.title: Crypto day trader loses it all
items.description: A trader livestreams a leveraged bet, watches the chart crash and shouts at the screen.

items.title: Office prank: the stapler in jelly
items.description: A coworker finds his stapler set inside a bowl of jelly and slowly realises who did it.

items.title: Stand-up: airports are a scam
items.description: A comedian riffs on airport security lines, overpriced sandwiches and gate changes. Contains strong language.

items.title: Grandma reviews energy drinks
items.description: A grandmother tastes five energy drinks and rates each one with deadpan honesty.

items.title: When the group project is due tomorrow
items.description: A sketch about four students who start a group project at midnight, fuelled by pizza and panic.
